newsitem.title: USA: Marsh & Mclennan okays split, ups dividend.
newsitem.headline: Marsh & Mclennan okays split, ups dividend.

text.p: Marsh & McLennan Cos Inc said Wednesday its board has declared a two-for one stock split for shareholders of record on June 6, with certificates to be issued on June 27.
It said that the split will raise the company's total shares outstanding to 166 million, from 83 million.

It said that the board also voted to raise the company's quarterly dividend by 11 percent to $1.00 to $0.90 on a pre-split basis. The dividend is payable on August 15 to stockholders of record on July 11, it said.
On a post-split basis the quarterly dividend is equivalent to $0.50 a share, it said.
Earlier today, the company's management recommended the stock split and the raising of the dividend.
Marsh & McLennan is an insurance, investment management and consulting services company.
